basic_profile.bio: A seasoned gamer who has been part of the gaming community for over a decade. Originally from Seattle, I work as a freelance photogrammetrist, which blends my love for technology and art. Gaming is my main hobby, particularly enjoying fast-paced FPS games like Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War. I’m usually online during evenings and late nights. In a relationship; my partner is also a gaming enthusiast. I dislike toxicity in gaming communities and appreciate a good, strategic match.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid background in photogrammetry, which I studied in college, and have been applying it in various freelance projects for the past few years. My expertise in gaming comes from years of playing and analyzing FPS games, along with keeping up with gaming trends and updates.
